python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, re

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'

z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
items = z.namelist()
sheet = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

rows = list(range(2, 10))
C = {r: int(re.search(r'<c r="C%d" t="n"><v>(\d+)</v></c>' % r, sheet).group(1)) for r in rows}
D = {r: int(re.search(r'<c r="D%d" t="n"><v>(\d+)</v></c>' % r, sheet).group(1)) for r in rows}
F = {r: int(re.search(r'<c r="F%d" t="n"><v>(\d+)</v></c>' % r, sheet).group(1)) for r in rows}

vals = {}
for r in rows:
    rev = C[r] * D[r]
    profit = rev - C[r] * F[r]
    vals[r] = (rev, profit, profit / rev)
tot_rev = sum(vals[r][0] for r in rows)
tot_profit = sum(vals[r][1] for r in rows)
vals[10] = (tot_rev, tot_profit, tot_profit / tot_rev)
tot_units = sum(C[r] for r in rows)

def num(x):
    return repr(x)

# styles: add percentage formats (numFmtId 10 = built-in "0.00%")
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="5">')
styles = styles.replace(
    '</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="10" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '<xf numFmtId="10" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
    '</cellXfs>')

# sheet: dimension + column width
sheet = sheet.replace('dimension ref="A1:G10"', 'dimension ref="A1:H10"')
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>')

# header cell
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
    '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c>')

# data rows: cached values + margin formula
for r in rows:
    sheet = sheet.replace(
        '<c r="E%d"><f>C%d*D%d</f><v></v></c>' % (r, r, r),
        '<c r="E%d"><f>C%d*D%d</f><v>%s</v></c>' % (r, r, r, num(vals[r][0])))
    sheet = sheet.replace(
        '<c r="G%d"><f>E%d-C%d*F%d</f><v></v></c>' % (r, r, r, r),
        '<c r="G%d"><f>E%d-C%d*F%d</f><v>%s</v></c>' % (r, r, r, r, num(vals[r][1])))
    sheet = sheet.replace(
        '</row>',
        '<c r="H%d" s="3"><f>G%d/E%d</f><v>%s</v></c></row>' % (r, r, r, num(vals[r][2])),
        1)

# total row
sheet = sheet.replace('<c r="C10"><f>SUM(C2:C9)</f><v></v></c>',
                      '<c r="C10"><f>SUM(C2:C9)</f><v>%s</v></c>' % tot_units)
sheet = sheet.replace('<c r="E10"><f>SUM(E2:E9)</f><v></v></c>',
                      '<c r="E10"><f>SUM(E2:E9)</f><v>%s</v></c>' % num(tot_rev))
sheet = sheet.replace('<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>',
                      '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v>%s</v></c>' % num(tot_profit))
sheet = sheet.replace('</row>',
                      '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v>%s</v></c></row>' % num(vals[10][2]), 1)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
    for name in items:
        data = z.read(name)
        if name == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = sheet.encode('utf-8')
        elif name == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = styles.encode('utf-8')
        out.writestr(name, data)
z.close()
print('updated')
EOF
